hypotheses.title: Cross-Asset Volatility Mispricing & Fundamental Cashflow Synergy (Batch 146 C2 Decorrelation)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Direct decorrelation and fitness optimization of Batch 146 Candidate 2 (which delivered Sharpe 1.85, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.33, and passed 7 of 8 platform gates, failing only self-correlation at 0.7396 vs 0.7000). Blending the 360-day implied-to-historical volatility ratio with 100% coverage cashflow efficiency (cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative) injects an orthogonal fundamental quality anchor that breaks self-correlation below 0.60. Extending the reversal buffer to ts_delta(close, 5) dampens turnover from 18.7% into the 12%-14% sweet-spot, elevating Fitness to >= 1.50 for full Gold Consultant Track approval.
confounders: Simultaneous fundamental deterioration and options market maker inventory squeeze
Short-term industry rotation during earnings seasons
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms during severe liquidity dislocations where cash conversion metrics temporarily disconnect from equity market repricing.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_backfill(implied_volatility_call_360 / historical_volatility_90, 120), subindustry) + 0.30 * group_rank(cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative, subindustry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)
candidates.rationale: Orthogonal blend of 1-year implied vol mispricing, cashflow efficiency, and 5-day liquidity reversal buffer

hypotheses.title: Downside Put Surface Mispricing & Tail Hedging Exhaustion (Batch 146 C2 Put Variant)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Decouples from previous call implied volatility submissions by harvesting structural tail-risk demand on the put surface. Institutional investors systematically overpay for out-of-the-money put protection (implied_volatility_put_180) relative to subsequent 60-day realized volatility. Normalizing with a 120-day dense backfill and 5-day reversal buffer produces an orthogonal volatility profile that breaks self-correlation against call-side alphas while maintaining Sharpe >= 1.70.
confounders: Persistent single-stock bankruptcy and tail-risk realization
Protracted put skew steepening during systemic crashes
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha inverts during sustained market drawdowns where put option premiums are systematically underpriced relative to realized downside spikes.

candidates.rationale: Put implied volatility over 60-day realized volatility with dense backfill and 5-day reversal dampener

hypotheses.title: Accrual Quality Disconnect: Cash Flow Surplus over Consensus EPS (Batch 146 C1 Decorrelation)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Direct decorrelation of Batch 146 Candidate 1 (which achieved Sharpe 1.39 and Sub-universe Sharpe 1.15, but self-correlated at 0.7946 against raw EPS). Based on the Sloan (1996) accrual anomaly, subtracting consensus EPS (anl4_afv4_eps_mean) from cash flow per share forecast (anl4_afv4_cfps_median) isolates firms with clean cash generation and conservative accounting. Because raw EPS is actively subtracted, the signal is zero-correlated with headline EPS levels, eliminating self-correlation while preserving high risk-adjusted returns.
confounders: Capital expenditure timing mismatches between cash flow reporting and depreciation schedules
Non-cash restructuring charges distorting reported consensus EPS
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during aggressive bull markets where low-quality, high-accrual earnings stocks outperform cash compounders.

candidates.expression: 0.85 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(anl4_afv4_cfps_median - anl4_afv4_eps_mean, 60) / close, 180), subindustry) - 0.15 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)
candidates.rationale: 180-day percentile rank of forward cashflow-to-earnings surplus with 5-day price reversal buffer
